title: VTG PLAYBOY MAGAZINE MAY 1987 VANNA WHITE Complete With Centerfold
descriptionText: The product is a vintage Playboy magazine from May 1987 featuring actress Vanna White. This edition comes complete with the centerfold intact, making it a desirable collectible for fans of classic men's magazines. The magazine is published by the Playboy Group in the United States and is written in English. With a focus on topics such as photography and modeling, this illustrated publication offers a glimpse into the cultural and entertainment trends of the time.
